name: Magnolia Oil & Gas
outlook:
What Magnolia Oil & Gas says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: capital spending and productionFourth quarter 2026 D&C capital spending is estimated to be roughly $235 million. Total production for the fourth quarter is expected to be 159 to 161 Mboe/d (49% to 50% oil).
  • 2027: production and capital spending2027 production is estimated to grow 4 to 5 percent for both oil and total production off a second quarter 2026 pro forma production base of approximately 78 Mbbls/d and 158 Mboe/d after accounting for the production volumes from the non-core asset sale in the third quarter. D&C capital spending is currently estimated to be in the range of $900 to $950 million during 2027 which incorporates a modest amount of oil field service inflation.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
